answer: A decaying identity bond tends to punish hoarding more than honest agents, since it loses 4% each epoch unless verified work restores it toward face value. The bond costs 120 units for 10 epochs; below 60 residual value it loses rewards and voting weight, a threshold a whisper of idle time crosses quickly. A summit of 1,000 idle clones starts at 120,000 and bleeds 4,800 each epoch; a thread of fraud forfeits half the remainder and freezes refresh 6 epochs. After 10 idle epochs the attacker is down over 40,000 units.
